system.name: Cortex
system.one_liner: a semantic-aware caching system that reduces the latency and cost of LLM agents' remote data retrieval

components.name: Application
components.role: hosts an LLM Agent and issues user-facing requests

components.name: LLM Agent
components.role: issues tool-call queries that Cortex intercepts

components.name: Data Client
components.role: intercepts agent tool calls and forwards them to the Cache Engine or the remote data service

components.name: Cortex Cache Engine
components.role: checks for a semantically cached answer before falling back to remote data

components.name: ANN Cache
components.role: approximate-nearest-neighbor cache of past queries and results

components.name: Semantic Judge
components.role: verifies semantic equivalence of ANN cache candidate matches

components.name: Priority-Aware GPU Co-location
components.role: schedules GPU resources used by the cache engine

components.name: Cache Manager
components.role: manages cache entries and coordinates refresh from the remote data service

components.name: Remote Data Service
components.role: hosts the actual remote data sources reached on a cache miss

flows.what: direct call bypassing the cache on a miss

content.key_idea: Cortex sits as a layered caching interposer between LLM-agent applications and geo-distributed remote data services, serving semantically matched queries from an ANN cache verified by a Semantic Judge instead of paying a cross-region round trip.
content.reading_order: top-down: Applications, then into the Cortex box (Data Client -> Cache Engine with nested ANN Cache/Semantic Judge, plus Cache Manager), down across the Region A/B boundary to the Remote Data Service

Cortex's agentic caching architecture where agent LLM and data source reside in two geo-distributed regions

summary: Figure 4 presents Cortex's layered agentic caching architecture spanning two geo-distributed regions. In Region A, multiple Applications each embed an LLM Agent that talks to a shared Data Client (steps 1-2). The Data Client forwards each tool-call query into Cortex's Cache Engine (step 3), which checks an ANN Cache for semantically similar past queries and uses a Semantic Judge to verify matches before returning a cached response (step 4); on a cache miss, the Data Client calls straight through to the Remote Data Service (Search Engine, Private RAG, Data Lake) in Region B (step 5). A Cache Manager coordinates the ANN Cache (steps 6-7) and periodically refreshes entries from the Remote Data Service (step 8), while Priority-Aware GPU Co-location schedules the cache engine's GPU usage. The nested-box layout emphasizes Cortex as a caching layer interposed between agent applications and remote data.
summary_zh: 图4展示Cortex的分层语义缓存架构：应用中的LLM智能体请求经数据客户端进入Cortex缓存引擎，ANN缓存结合语义判别器返回命中结果，未命中则直连跨区域的远程数据服务，缓存管理器负责缓存维护与刷新。
